The value is a gmeow:Gender individual: a predefined one, or — when none fits — a fresh individual carrying rdfs:label (the custom-PronounSet idiom). The single path to the gender value; there is deliberately no flat datatype shortcut.
- gmeow:generalizesVia: Projection-compiler guidance naming the transitive part/whole property to walk when coarsening a value (e.g. gmeow:containedInPlace for places). Defaults to gmeow:partOf when absent. An annotation property — it directs generalization without imposing logical semantics, keeping the core OWL 2 DL.
- gmeow:geometryDeterminacy [gmeow:Geometry → gmeow:Determinacy]: The ontic determinacy model of a geometry's boundary — crisp (surveyed), vague (approximate), fuzzy (probabilistic), or disputed. Non-functional: competing source classifications coexist.
- gmeow:geometryType [gmeow:Geometry → gmeow:GeometryType]: The structural kind of a geometry (a gmeow:GeometryType individual). Non-functional: competing source classifications may differ (e.g. polygon vs multipolygon) and must coexist as evidence.
- gmeow:hasAgreement [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Agreement]: Relates an agent to an agreement it is party to. The party-ship period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on this statement; the agreement's own term/effective dates live on the gmeow:Agreement individual (no double-modelling).
- gmeow:hasAncestor [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to an ancestor — a parent, a parent's parent, and so on. Transitive: an ancestor of an ancestor is an ancestor. gmeow:hasParent (hence gmeow:hasMother / hasFather) is a sub-property, so ancestry is DERIVED from parentage by the reasoner and is never asserted directly.
- gmeow:hasAppellation [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Appellation]: Relates an entity to an appellation (name-object) it bears. The universal name-bearing property; gmeow:hasName is the person-scoped specialization. Non-functional — entities bear many co-equal names; a bearing's period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement, or reified as a gmeow:NameUsage when audience/register/evidence must be borne.
- gmeow:hasAttachment [gmeow:Message → gmeow:Attachment]: Relates a message to one of its attachments.
- gmeow:hasAuthenticationResult [gmeow:Message → gmeow:AuthenticationResult]: Relates a message to an authentication check performed on it.
- gmeow:hasAuthor [gmeow:CreativeWork → gmeow:Agent]: Relates a creative work to an agent chiefly responsible for creating its intellectual content.
- gmeow:hasAxis [gmeow:ReferenceFrame → gmeow:Axis]: Relates a reference frame to one of its coordinate axes.
- gmeow:hasBin [gmeow:SpatialAggregation → gmeow:SpatialBin]: Links a spatial aggregation to one of its constituent spatial bins. Non-functional: a bin may participate in multiple aggregations.
- gmeow:hasBodyPart [gmeow:Message → gmeow:BodyPart]: Relates a message to a MIME part of its body. A MIME-structure specialization of the universal gmeow:hasPart spine.
- gmeow:hasChild [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a child; the inverse of hasParent.
- gmeow:hasContactPoint [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:ContactPoint]: Relates an agent to a means of contacting it.
- gmeow:hasCoordinateMatrix [gmeow:Axis | gmeow:Pose → rdfs:Literal]: Specifies a transformation or projection matrix associated with a coordinate axis, or a homogeneous 4×4 pose matrix combining translation and rotation.
- gmeow:hasCoordinates [gmeow:Place → gmeow:GeoCoordinates]: Relates a place to its geographic point coordinates.
- gmeow:hasCopyright [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Copyright]: Relates a work to its reified copyright.
- gmeow:hasCreationEvent [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Event]: Links an entity to the event that brought it into existence — the general form of birth (person), founding (organization), minting (currency), or realization (reference frame). Non-functional: competing standpoint-indexed creation claims coexist, none privileged. A Person's birth event is ALSO typed gmeow:eventTypeBirth (co-equal value, not a subclass).
- gmeow:hasDataController [gmeow:RightsStatement → gmeow:Agent]: The data controller responsible for processing personal data under a rights statement — the agent that determines the purposes and means of processing.
- gmeow:hasDataSubject [gmeow:RightsStatement → gmeow:Agent]: The data subject whose personal data is governed by a rights statement — the individual about whom personal data is processed. Not a subproperty of gmeow:hasParty because a rights statement (an ODRL policy) is not an agreement; the party model is reused at the licence level.
- gmeow:hasDescendant [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a descendant — a child, a child's child, and so on; the transitive inverse of gmeow:hasAncestor. Derived by the reasoner (gmeow:hasChild is a sub-property), never asserted directly.
- gmeow:hasDestructionEvent [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Event]: Links an entity to the event that ended its existence — the general form of death (person), dissolution (organization), destruction (place), or retirement (frame, software). Non-functional: competing standpoint-indexed destruction claims coexist. A Person's death event is ALSO typed gmeow:eventTypeDeath. Suppression (gmeow:displayable false) is a display contract; destruction is an ontic fact — the entity is retained, merely marked as no longer extant.
- gmeow:hasDeterminacy [? → gmeow:Determinacy]: Relates a value, entity, or claim to its ontic determinacy model — the explicit facet recording whether the value is crisp, vague, fuzzy, probabilistic, or disputed. Domain-free (universal, like hasGranularity). NOT functional: in a multi-source merge sources may state different determinacy models, and those claims coexist rather than force the reasoner to collapse distinct models. Distinct from gmeow:confidence (epistemic certainty) and from gmeow:determinacyModel (the frame-level default for a ReferenceFrame).
- gmeow:hasDuration [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Duration]: Relates an event to its duration (a gmeow:Duration). Distinct from gmeow:eventInterval (which anchors the event in time); a duration is a length only.
- gmeow:hasDuty [gmeow:RightsStatement | gmeow:Permission → gmeow:Duty]: Relates a rights statement (or a permission) to a duty / obligation that must be discharged (an odrl:duty / odrl:obligation rule). The domain is the union of gmeow:RightsStatement and gmeow:Permission, so a permission may carry its own duties without being misclassified as a rights statement.
- gmeow:hasEndInstant [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:Instant] (functional): The end instant of a time interval; absent if the interval is open-ended.
- gmeow:hasFather [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a male parent.
- gmeow:hasGenderExpression [gmeow:Person → gmeow:GenderExpression]: Relates a person to a self-asserted gender-expression facet. Non-functional and contextual. MUST NOT be inferred from gmeow:hasGenderIdentity, gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth, pronouns or honorifics.
- gmeow:hasGenderIdentity [gmeow:Person → gmeow:GenderIdentity]: Relates a person to a self-asserted gender-identity facet they hold. Non-functional and contextual — a person bears many co-equal identities; a superseded one is kept with gmeow:displayable false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from gmeow:hasPronounSet, gmeow:honorific, gmeow:hasGenderExpression or gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth.
- gmeow:hasGeometry [gmeow:Place → gmeow:Geometry]: Relates a place to its spatial geometry (point, line, or polygon).
- gmeow:hasGranularity [? → gmeow:GranularityLevel]: Relates a value, place, period, coordinate or measurement to its own resolution level — the explicit 'no silent precision' facet, queryable independently of any disclosure control. Domain-free. NOT functional: in a multi-source merge sources may state different resolutions, and those claims coexist rather than force the reasoner to collapse distinct levels.
- gmeow:hasHeader [gmeow:Message → gmeow:MessageHeader]: Relates a message to one of its RFC 5322 headers.
- gmeow:hasKeyword [gmeow:Message → gmeow:MessageKeyword]: Relates a message to a flag/keyword applied to it.
- gmeow:hasLicense [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:License]: Relates an entity (a work, dataset, software project, …) to a licence granting rights in it (dcterms:license; schema:license). Named gmeow:hasLicense — gmeow:license is reserved for the mapping-DSL set-license datatype property.
- gmeow:hasMember [gmeow:Organization → gmeow:Agent]: Relates an organization to one of its member agents; the inverse of memberOf.
- gmeow:hasMet [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Agent]: Records that two agents have met; symmetric. The occasion/period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.
- gmeow:hasMetricKind [gmeow:ReferenceFrame → gmeow:MetricKind] (functional): The distance or dissimilarity metric declared by this reference frame. Functional: a frame uses exactly one metric kind for all proximity computations expressed in it. The actual computation is performed by the solver (Principle 12), never materialised as asserted triples in the OWL core.
- gmeow:hasMother [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a female parent.
- gmeow:hasName [gmeow:Person → gmeow:PersonName]: Relates a person to a structured, typed PersonName they bear; the person-scoped specialization of gmeow:hasAppellation. Non-functional — a person bears many co-equal names.
- gmeow:hasNamePart [gmeow:Appellation → gmeow:NamePart]: Relates an appellation to one of its reified, typed parts. Non-functional — a name has many parts. A specialized information-object component relation under the universal gmeow:hasPart spine.
- gmeow:hasOccupation [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Occupation]: Relates a person to an occupation they hold or have held.
- gmeow:hasParent [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a parent (any kind: biological, adoptive, step, or foster). Non-functional: contested parentage claims from multiple sources coexist as standpoint-indexed statements (gmeow:accordingTo), never collapsing to a single winner (Principle 9).
- gmeow:hasPart: Universal whole-to-part inverse of gmeow:partOf. Transitive and intentionally broad; specialized component and containment properties remain the authoritative source for domain-specific meaning.
- gmeow:hasParticipant [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Agent]: An agent that took part in an event — the flat 80%-case shortcut. Non-functional. Promote to a gmeow:Participation node when the role, period, confidence, or evidence of the participation must be recorded.
- gmeow:hasPartner [gmeow:CoupleRelationship → gmeow:Person]: Relates a couple relationship to one of its two partners.
- gmeow:hasParty [gmeow:Agreement → gmeow:Agent]: Relates an agreement to an agent that is bound by it.
- gmeow:hasPermission [gmeow:RightsStatement → gmeow:Permission]: Relates a rights statement to a permission it grants (an odrl:permission rule).
- gmeow:hasPlaceName [gmeow:Place → gmeow:PlaceName]: Relates a geographic gmeow:Place to a structured gmeow:PlaceName (toponym) it bears; the place-scoped specialization of gmeow:hasAppellation, mirroring gmeow:hasName for persons. Non-functional — a place bears many co-equal names (endonym/exonym, multilingual, historical); none is primary, and superseded ones set gmeow:displayable false. The structured, first-class replacement for the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal.
- gmeow:hasPose [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Pose]: Associates an entity with a frame-relative pose (position + orientation).
- gmeow:hasPoseOrientation [gmeow:Pose → gmeow:Orientation]: The rotational component of a pose.
- gmeow:hasPosePosition [gmeow:Pose → gmeow:SpatialCoordinates]: The translational component of a pose, expressed as spatial coordinates in the pose frame.
- gmeow:hasPrivacyNotice [? → gmeow:PrivacyNotice]: Relates an entity or rights statement to its privacy notice. Domain-free: a notice may be attached to a RightsStatement, a Licence, or directly to the governed entity.
- gmeow:hasProfile [? → gmeow:Profile]: Links an entity, value or frame to the Profile that governs its structure.
- gmeow:hasProhibition [gmeow:RightsStatement → gmeow:Prohibition]: Relates a rights statement to a prohibition it imposes (an odrl:prohibition rule).
- gmeow:hasPronounSet [gmeow:Person → gmeow:PronounSet]: Relates a person to a pronoun set they go by. Non-functional and contextual (scope a context-specific set with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement, or via a NameUsage). A form of ADDRESS, sex/gender-independent — MUST NOT be inferred from gender identity/expression, sex-assigned-at-birth or orientation.
- gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule [gmeow:EventSeries → gmeow:RecurrenceRule]: Relates an event series to the recurrence rule by which it repeats.
- gmeow:hasReferenceFrame [? → gmeow:ReferenceFrame]: Relates an entity or value to the reference frame in which it is expressed.
- gmeow:hasRelayHop [gmeow:Message → gmeow:RelayHop]: Relates a message to a hop in its delivery path.
- gmeow:hasRepository [gmeow:SoftwareProject → gmeow:Repository]: Relates a software project to a source-code repository.
- gmeow:hasRightsStatement [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:RightsStatement]: Relates an entity (typically a gmeow:CreativeWork or gmeow:InformationObject) to a machine-readable rights statement that governs it — the GMEOW analogue of odrl:hasPolicy.
- gmeow:hasRole [gmeow:Membership → gmeow:Role]: Relates a membership to the role the member plays.
- gmeow:hasRomanticOrientation [gmeow:Person → gmeow:RomanticOrientation]: Relates a person to a self-asserted romantic-orientation facet. Non-functional and contextual; a superseded one is kept with gmeow:displayable false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from gmeow:hasSexualOrientation, gmeow:hasGenderIdentity, gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth, pronouns or honorifics.
- gmeow:hasRoute [owl:Thing → gmeow:Route]: Relates a thing to a route that starts from, ends at, or passes through it.
- gmeow:hasRouteSegment [gmeow:Route → gmeow:Route]: A sub-route that is part of a larger route. A specialization of the universal gmeow:hasPart spine.
- gmeow:hasSensitivity [? → gmeow:SensitivityLevel]: Relates a value, entity, or claim to its privacy-sensitivity level — the explicit facet that drives disclosure-control decisions (coarsenTo / displayable) at projection time under a consent guard. Domain-free (universal, like hasGranularity and hasDeterminacy). NOT functional: in a multi-source merge sources may state different sensitivity levels, and those claims coexist rather than force the reasoner to collapse distinct levels. Distinct from gmeow:confidence (epistemic certainty) and from gmeow:hasDeterminacy (ontic model).
- gmeow:hasSexualOrientation [gmeow:Person → gmeow:SexualOrientation]: Relates a person to a self-asserted sexual-orientation facet. Non-functional and contextual; a superseded one is kept with gmeow:displayable false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from gmeow:hasRomanticOrientation, gmeow:hasGenderIdentity, gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth, pronouns or honorifics.
- gmeow:hasSibling [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a sibling; symmetric.
- gmeow:hasSignature [gmeow:Message → gmeow:CryptographicSignature]: Relates a message to a cryptographic signature over it.
- gmeow:hasSkill [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Skill]: Relates an agent to a skill it possesses.
- gmeow:hasSource [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Source]: Relates an entity or reified claim to a source that provides evidence for it. The strength of that evidence is recorded with gmeow:confidence on the supported statement.
- gmeow:hasSpouse [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Person]: Relates a person to a spouse; symmetric.
- gmeow:hasStartInstant [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:Instant] (functional): The start instant of a time interval.
- gmeow:hasSubEvent [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Relates an event to a constituent sub-event; the transitive inverse of gmeow:subEventOf.
- gmeow:hasTag [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Tag]: Relates an entity to a user-minted tag — the 80% flat shortcut. Non-functional: an entity may carry many co-equal tags. Period, confidence, tagger and suppression are carried via RDF-star statement annotations (gmeow:validFrom, gmeow:validUntil, gmeow:confidence, gmeow:displayable) on the shortcut; promote to a gmeow:Tagging relator when the act itself must be a node.
- gmeow:hasTemporalFrame [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TemporalFrame]: Relates a time interval to the temporal frame in which its bounds are expressed.
- gmeow:hasTemporalMeasurement [? → gmeow:TemporalMeasurement]: Relates an entity (event, artifact, place, sample) to a temporal measurement assigned to it.
- gmeow:hasTrademark [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Trademark]: Relates an entity (a mark, product or organization) to a trademark right over it.
- gmeow:hasUnit [? → qudt:Unit] (functional): Relates a quantitative value or measurement to its QUDT unit (by reference, never imported). Domain-free: used by temporal measurements, spatial measurements, and any other quantified claim.
- gmeow:hasUsed [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Entity]: Records that an agent has used some entity (a tool, service, or work). The period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.
- gmeow:hasWebPage [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:WebPage]: Relates an entity to a web page representing it — a homepage, a profile page, a project site. The structured form of a 'website / URL' field: the page is a first-class gmeow:WebPage (documents module) whose IRI is its URL, so it can itself carry a title, language, and rights. Non-functional — an entity may have several pages.
- gmeow:hasWorkedWith [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Agent]: Records that two agents have worked together; symmetric. The period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement, or reified as a gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship.
- gmeow:headerName [gmeow:MessageHeader → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The field name of a message header.
- gmeow:headerValue [gmeow:MessageHeader → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The field value of a message header.
- gmeow:heading [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: The compass direction an entity is facing, typically clockwise from north, in degrees.
- gmeow:holdsAccount [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:OnlineAccount]: Relates an agent to an online account it holds.
- gmeow:holdsKey [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:CryptographicKey]: Relates an agent to a cryptographic key it holds. The period over which the agent held the key may be carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on this statement.
- gmeow:honorific [gmeow:Person → gmeow:Honorific]: An honorific/title of address for a person (a gmeow:Honorific value). Non-functional and contextual. A form of ADDRESS, sex/gender-independent — MUST NOT be inferred from gender identity/expression, sex-assigned-at-birth or orientation.
- gmeow:honorificClass [gmeow:Honorific → gmeow:HonorificClass]: The domain/class of an honorific (academic, clerical, noble, military, judicial, social).
- gmeow:honorificPosition [gmeow:Honorific → gmeow:HonorificPosition] (functional): Whether an honorific is rendered before (prefix) or after (suffix) the name.
- gmeow:hopOrdinal [gmeow:RelayHop → xsd:integer] (functional): The position of a hop within the message path (1 = closest to the origin).
- gmeow:identifier [gmeow:CreativeWork → rdfs:Literal]: A formal identifier of a creative work, such as a DOI or patent number.
- gmeow:importanceLevel: Relative import/source importance of a claim on a 0–10 scale; projection takes the maximum across imports.
- gmeow:inReplyTo [gmeow:Message → gmeow:Message]: Relates a message to the message it directly replies to (RFC 5322 In-Reply-To).
- gmeow:inTemporalFrame [gmeow:Instant → gmeow:TemporalFrame]: Relates an instant to the temporal frame in which its value is expressed.
- gmeow:ingestedAt [gmeow:ImportActivity → xsd:dateTime] (functional): When an import activity recorded its claims into the system — the transaction time. Distinct from gmeow:assertedAt (observation) and gmeow:validFrom/validUntil (validity).
- gmeow:instantValue [gmeow:Instant → xsd:dateTime] (functional): The crisp instant as an xsd:dateTime literal in the associated temporal frame.
- gmeow:intersexVariation [gmeow:Person → rdfs:Literal]: An optional free-text note recording an intersex variation, for inclusivity where gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth gmeow:saabIntersex is insufficient. Deliberately a plain note, NOT a clinical DSD taxonomy and NOT a value vocabulary — GMEOW does not model medical sex characteristics in depth.
- gmeow:intervalAfter [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen AFTER: this interval begins strictly after the related interval ends. Transitive inverse of gmeow:intervalBefore. (= time:intervalAfter)
- gmeow:intervalBefore [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen BEFORE: this interval ends strictly before the related interval begins. Transitive. Inverse of gmeow:intervalAfter. (= time:intervalBefore)
- gmeow:intervalCoincidesWith [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen EQUALS: this interval and the related interval share the same temporal extent. Symmetric and transitive. TEMPORAL simultaneity only, never identity of the intervals themselves. (= time:intervalEquals)
- gmeow:intervalContains [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen CONTAINS: this interval's extent strictly contains the related interval's extent. Transitive inverse of gmeow:intervalDuring. (= time:intervalContains)
- gmeow:intervalDuring [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen DURING: this interval's extent falls strictly within the related interval's extent. Transitive. Inverse of gmeow:intervalContains. (= time:intervalDuring)
- gmeow:intervalFinishedBy [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen FINISHED-BY: inverse of gmeow:intervalFinishes. (= time:intervalFinishedBy)
- gmeow:intervalFinishes [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen FINISHES: this interval and the related interval end together, and this one began later. NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:intervalFinishedBy. (= time:intervalFinishes)
- gmeow:intervalMeets [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen MEETS: this interval ends exactly when the related interval begins. NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:intervalMetBy. (= time:intervalMeets)
- gmeow:intervalMetBy [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen MET-BY: inverse of gmeow:intervalMeets. (= time:intervalMetBy)
- gmeow:intervalOverlappedBy [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen OVERLAPPED-BY: inverse of gmeow:intervalOverlaps. (= time:intervalOverlappedBy)
- gmeow:intervalOverlaps [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen OVERLAPS: this interval begins before and ends during the related interval. NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:intervalOverlappedBy. (= time:intervalOverlaps)
- gmeow:intervalStartedBy [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen STARTED-BY: inverse of gmeow:intervalStarts. (= time:intervalStartedBy)
- gmeow:intervalStarts [gmeow:TimeInterval → gmeow:TimeInterval]: Allen STARTS: this interval and the related interval begin together, and this one ends first. NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:intervalStartedBy. (= time:intervalStarts)
- gmeow:introducerAmount [gmeow:TrustAssertion → xsd:integer] (functional): The trust-signature amount/weight the trustor assigns to the trustee as an introducer.
- gmeow:introducerDepth [gmeow:TrustAssertion → xsd:integer] (functional): The trust-signature depth: how many levels of indirect introducers the trustor is willing to follow (a trust-signature notion, not computed here).
- gmeow:isAbout [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Entity]: Aboutness — a resource is about another resource. Distinct from typing (rdf:type) and from tagging (gmeow:hasTag): aboutness is a semantic subject-matter relation, tagging is a user-applied label, and typing is an ontological classification. Non-functional.
- gmeow:isAccessibleForFree [gmeow:Entity → xsd:boolean]: Whether the asset is accessible without payment (schema:isAccessibleForFree).
- gmeow:isOsiApproved [gmeow:License → xsd:boolean]: Whether the licence is approved by the Open Source Initiative (spdx:isOsiApproved).
- gmeow:isResultOf [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Observation]: Relates an entity (typically an observation result such as a quantity, coordinate set, or quality value) back to the Observation that produced it — the explicit provenance axis of the value×unit/frame×determinacy×provenance bundle (#77). Domain is gmeow:Entity (universal, matching the range of observationResult) so any result type can carry provenance. Non-functional: a result entity may be produced by multiple observations (e.g. a consensus value derived from several readings), and those claims coexist rather than collapse.
- gmeow:jurisdictionDeterminacy [gmeow:JurisdictionTenure → gmeow:Determinacy]: The ontic determinacy model of this jurisdiction claim — crisp (well-defined border), vague (approximate boundary), fuzzy (probabilistic membership), or disputed (competing claims). Non-functional: sources may disagree on determinacy, and those claims coexist.
- gmeow:jurisdictionPlace [gmeow:JurisdictionTenure → gmeow:Place] (functional): The place whose governance is recorded by this JurisdictionTenure. Functional: a tenure concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity).
- gmeow:jurisdictionPolity [gmeow:JurisdictionTenure → gmeow:Agent] (functional): The governing polity (state, administrative body, or organization) that held jurisdiction over the place during this tenure. Functional: a single tenure has exactly one governing polity.
- gmeow:keyAlgorithm [gmeow:CryptographicKey → rdfs:Literal]: The key's algorithm (e.g. rsa, ed25519, secp256k1). Not functional (source-variable).
- gmeow:keyExpiresAt [gmeow:CryptographicKey → xsd:dateTime]: The instant a key is set to expire. Not functional (sources may report different expiry, and subkeys differ).
- gmeow:keyId [gmeow:CryptographicKey → rdfs:Literal]: A short identifier for a key (e.g. a PGP long key id). Not functional (source-variable).
- gmeow:keyMaterial [gmeow:CryptographicKey → rdfs:Literal]: The public key material itself (armored or hex form). Not functional (encodings vary by source).
- gmeow:keyScheme [gmeow:CryptographicKey → gmeow:KeyScheme] (functional): The scheme/format of a cryptographic key (one of the gmeow:KeyScheme individuals). Functional: a key has exactly one scheme — a key of a different scheme is a different key.
- gmeow:knowsLanguage [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Language]: Relates an agent to a language it knows. Non-functional. The leveled, per-skill detail is carried by the reified gmeow:LanguageProficiency.
- gmeow:languageCode [gmeow:Language → rdfs:Literal]: An OPTIONAL registry code for a language (a BCP-47 tag "ja", an ISO 639-3 code "jpn", a Glottocode). A see-also alignment value, NEVER identity — a code-less conlang or AI-language is fully first-class. Authoritative identity is the self-minted IRI; assert registry coreference with skos:exactMatch and gmeow:authorityLink. Non-functional (a language carries codes in several registries).
- gmeow:languageModality [gmeow:Language → gmeow:LanguageModality]: The sensory/transmission modality/modalities of a language (gmeow:LanguageModality individuals). Non-functional — many languages are multimodal (spoken and written).
- gmeow:languageOrigin [gmeow:Language → gmeow:LanguageOrigin]: The origin kind(s) of a language (gmeow:LanguageOrigin individuals). Non-functional — a contact language may be both creole and mixed.
- gmeow:languageStatus [gmeow:Language → gmeow:LanguageStatus]: The vitality status of a language (a gmeow:LanguageStatus value). Non-functional: source classifications coexist; period carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.
- gmeow:languageTag [gmeow:Language → xsd:string] (functional): The internal private-use BCP-47 language tag (e.g., 'x-gmeow-japanese') used for @lang annotations on string literals representing this language.
- gmeow:latestEnd [gmeow:Event → xsd:dateTime]: The latest instant by which an event must have ended — the upper bound of a fuzzy / approximate date (xsd:dateTime). Pairs with gmeow:earliestStart and a gmeow:temporalPrecision value.
- gmeow:latitude [gmeow:GeoCoordinates → xsd:decimal]: The latitude of a geographic point in decimal degrees.
- gmeow:leftOperand [gmeow:AtomicConstraint → gmeow:LeftOperand] (functional): The dimension an atomic constraint tests — one of the gmeow:LeftOperand values (odrl:leftOperand). Functional.
- gmeow:levelScale [gmeow:ProficiencyLevel → gmeow:ProficiencyScale] (functional): The scale a proficiency-level individual belongs to (e.g. cefrB2 levelScale scaleCEFR). Functional.
- gmeow:licenseFamily [gmeow:License → gmeow:LicenseFamily] (functional): The family a licence belongs to — one of the gmeow:LicenseFamily values. Functional.
- gmeow:licenseText [gmeow:License → rdfs:Literal]: The full legal text of a licence (spdx:licenseText).
- gmeow:licensedWork [gmeow:License → gmeow:InformationObject] (functional): The work a licence grants rights in. Functional.
- gmeow:licensee [gmeow:License → gmeow:Agent]: The party receiving a licence (odrl:assignee). A specialisation of gmeow:hasParty. Absent on an open / public licence offered to everyone.
- gmeow:licensor [gmeow:License → gmeow:Agent]: The party granting a licence (odrl:assigner). A specialisation of gmeow:hasParty. Non-functional: a licence may be granted jointly.
- gmeow:listId [gmeow:Message → rdfs:Literal]: The mailing-list identifier a message was distributed through (RFC 2919 List-Id).
- gmeow:locatedAt [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Location]: Relates an entity to a location it is situated at, resides in, or occurs at — geographic, virtual, or storage.
- gmeow:logicConstraintMember [gmeow:LogicalConstraint → gmeow:Constraint]: A member constraint combined by a logical constraint (odrl:operand). Non-functional: a logical constraint combines two or more.
- gmeow:longitude [gmeow:GeoCoordinates → xsd:decimal]: The longitude of a geographic point in decimal degrees.
- gmeow:mailboxName [gmeow:Mailbox → rdfs:Literal]: The display name of a mailbox or label.
- gmeow:mailboxOfAccount [gmeow:Mailbox → gmeow:OnlineAccount] (functional): Relates a mailbox to the online account that holds it.
- gmeow:mailboxRole [gmeow:Mailbox → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The special-use role of a mailbox (JMAP role): inbox, archive, drafts, sent, trash, junk, templates.
- gmeow:mappedFrom: The source property a claim was derived from during ingestion, recorded for mapping-step audit.
- gmeow:markText [gmeow:Mark → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The textual form of a mark (the brand name / word mark), e.g. "Blackcat Informatics".
- gmeow:measuredAge [gmeow:TemporalMeasurement → xsd:decimal] (functional): The numeric age yielded by a temporal measurement, in the unit given by gmeow:hasUnit.
- gmeow:measuredDate [gmeow:TemporalMeasurement → gmeow:Instant] (functional): The absolute date instant yielded by a temporal measurement.
- gmeow:measurementDeterminacy [gmeow:TemporalMeasurement → gmeow:Determinacy]: The ontic determinacy model of a temporal measurement — crisp, vague, fuzzy, probabilistic, or disputed (reuses the universal gmeow:Determinacy vocabulary, #71).
- gmeow:measurementMethod [gmeow:TemporalMeasurement → gmeow:DatingMethod] (functional): The dating method used for a temporal measurement.
- gmeow:measurementUncertainty [gmeow:TemporalMeasurement → xsd:decimal] (functional): The uncertainty (e.g. ±1 sigma) of a temporal measurement, in the same unit as the measured age.
- gmeow:mediaType [gmeow:BodyPart → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The MIME media type of a body part (e.g. text/plain, application/pdf).
- gmeow:meets [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Allen MEETS: this event ends exactly when the related event begins (no gap, no overlap). NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:metBy. (= time:intervalMeets; TimeML IBEFORE / immediately-before; TEO meets.)
- gmeow:memberOf [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Organization]: Relates an agent to an organization it belongs to.
- gmeow:membershipMember [gmeow:Membership → gmeow:Agent] (functional): The agent whose membership a gmeow:Membership reifies. Functional — a membership concerns one member (the relator's member role); the flat gmeow:memberOf is the agent→organization shortcut, this connects the reified relator to its member so role and period can be carried.
- gmeow:membershipOrganization [gmeow:Membership → gmeow:Organization] (functional): The organization a gmeow:Membership is in. Functional — a membership concerns one organization (which may be a department, i.e. a gmeow:subOrganizationOf a larger org).
- gmeow:metBy [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Allen MET-BY: this event begins exactly when the related event ends; inverse of gmeow:meets. (= time:intervalMetBy; TimeML IAFTER; TEO metBy.)
- gmeow:name [gmeow:Entity → rdfs:Literal]: A simple label by which an entity is known — the rdfs:label tier, for entities that do not need the full naming apparatus (organizations, software agents, sources, keys). Persons' names are modelled as gmeow:PersonName (names module); a flat given/family ('First Last') rendering is produced by downcasting that structured model in the projection layer, not stored here. Carries no precedence over an entity's other names. Language-tag the literal where applicable.
- gmeow:nameLanguage [gmeow:Appellation → gmeow:Language] (functional): The first-class gmeow:Language an appellation's surface form is in. Language is ALWAYS a first-class gmeow:Language (registry-INDEPENDENT, self-minted IRI) — never a bare BCP-47 literal; codes (e.g. "ja", "zh") live on the Language via gmeow:languageCode, so a code-less conlang or AI-minted language names co-equally. FUNCTIONAL — exactly one language per appellation: co-equal multilingual names are modelled as SEPARATE co-equal gmeow:Appellation instances (one per language), never by multi-tagging a single name (that is what keeps naming anti-colonial and symmetric). Drives locale-relative, symmetric display selection — never a ranking of one name above another. The script the form is written in is gmeow:nameScript (bridging to a first-class gmeow:WritingSystem).
- gmeow:namePartType [gmeow:NamePart → gmeow:NamePartType] (functional): The kind of a name part (a gmeow:NamePartType value). Functional: a single part has one kind — a part that is both a surname and a patronymic is modelled as two parts.
- gmeow:namePurpose [gmeow:Appellation → gmeow:NamePurpose]: The intrinsic kind/purpose(s) of an appellation (legal, birth, chosen, professional, deadname, …) — a gmeow:NamePurpose value. Non-functional: a name may be both legal and chosen.
- gmeow:nameScript [gmeow:Appellation → rdfs:Literal]: The ISO 15924 script code of an appellation (e.g. "Hani", "Arab", "Latn"). Available explicitly for indexing alongside a BCP-47 script subtag on the literal.
- gmeow:narrowerTag [gmeow:Tag → gmeow:Tag]: A narrower, more specific tag. Inverse of gmeow:broaderTag. Optional.
- gmeow:nativeLanguage [gmeow:Agent → gmeow:Language]: Relates an agent to a native (mother-tongue / first) language — a specialization of gmeow:knowsLanguage. Non-functional: a person may have several native languages.
- gmeow:nip05 [gmeow:OnlineAccount → rdfs:Literal]: A Nostr NIP-05 identifier (user@domain) verifying a Nostr account against a domain.
- gmeow:nostrPubkey [gmeow:OnlineAccount → rdfs:Literal]: The Nostr public key (npub / hex) identifying a decentralized-identity account.
- gmeow:observationEvent [gmeow:Observation → gmeow:Event]: The event during which the observation was made — a survey, a census, an excavation, a clinical trial. Links an observation to the temporal occurrence that produced it. For the generating activity (provenance), use gmeow:wasGeneratedBy; this property is the *event* perspective (when did it happen).
- gmeow:observationMethod [gmeow:Observation → gmeow:ObservationMethod] (functional): The method or protocol used to produce the observation. Functional: one method per observation (compound protocols are modelled as a single fused method individual, e.g. 'GPS-RTK survey with ground control'). Distinct from gmeow:vantage: the method is *how* it was done, the vantage is *who* did it.
- gmeow:observationResult [gmeow:Observation → gmeow:Entity]: The entity-valued result of an observation — a coordinate set, an instant, a quality value, a quantity, or another entity. For literal scalar readings (e.g. 22.5°C), the observationResult entity carries the literal via a datatype property (e.g. qudt:quantityValue or a module-specific scalar property). Non-functional: a single observation may yield several results in different frames or granularities, and competing result claims coexist rather than collapse.
- gmeow:observationType [gmeow:Observation → gmeow:ObservationType]: The kind(s) of observation being made — measurement, sensory reading, standpoint claim, derived inference, etc. Non-functional: an observation may be both a measurement and a derived inference (e.g. a calibrated sensor reading that is also machine-learned), and competing type classifications coexist.
- gmeow:observedFeature [gmeow:Observation → gmeow:Entity]: The entity whose property or state is being observed — the feature of interest. Range is gmeow:Entity (not a narrower type) because anything can be observed: a place, a person, an event, a document, a quality value.
- gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries [gmeow:Event → gmeow:EventSeries]: Relates a concrete event occurrence to the series that issued it; the inverse of gmeow:seriesOccurrence.
- gmeow:overlappedBy [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Allen OVERLAPPED-BY: inverse of gmeow:overlaps. (= time:intervalOverlappedBy; TEO overlappedBy.)
- gmeow:overlaps [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Allen OVERLAPS: this event begins before, and ends during, the related event (their extents partially overlap). NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:overlappedBy. (= time:intervalOverlaps; TEO overlaps.)
- gmeow:parentFrame [gmeow:ReferenceFrame → gmeow:ReferenceFrame] (functional): Relates a reference frame to its parent frame in a hierarchy.
- gmeow:partExpansion [gmeow:NamePart → rdfs:Literal]: The expanded form of an abbreviated part — e.g. the full word a South-Indian (Tamil) initial stands for.
- gmeow:partOf: Universal part-to-whole relation: relates any GMEOW thing to a larger whole it is part of. Transitive and intentionally broad; use specialized subproperties such as gmeow:containedInLocation, gmeow:subOrganizationOf, gmeow:subEventOf, gmeow:partOfThread or module-specific component properties when the kind of parthood matters. No domain/range is asserted so event, location, information-object and endurant parthood all remain possible in OWL 2 DL.
- gmeow:partOfThread [gmeow:Message → gmeow:Thread]: Relates a message to the thread (conversation) it belongs to. A conversation-thread specialization of the universal gmeow:partOf spine.
- gmeow:partOrder [gmeow:NamePart → xsd:nonNegativeInteger] (functional): The 0-based position of a part within its appellation's surface order, as actually written in its culture. Records observed order WITHOUT implying a given-before-family default — East-Asian family-first is simply order 0 = surname.
- gmeow:partText [gmeow:NamePart → rdfs:Literal]: The string value of a name part. Language-/script-tag the literal where applicable.
- gmeow:participationEvent [gmeow:Participation → gmeow:Event] (functional): The event a participation is part of (functional — one event per participation).
- gmeow:participationInterval [gmeow:Participation → gmeow:TimeInterval]: The time interval over which the participation held. (A relator carries its period this way — matching usageInterval / relationshipInterval — rather than via duringInterval.)
- gmeow:participationParticipant [gmeow:Participation → gmeow:Entity]: The entity that took part in the event in this participation. Range is gmeow:Entity (not only Agent) to admit non-agent participants — a document signed, a place visited. Non-functional: a joint role may be borne by several participants.
- gmeow:participationRole [gmeow:Participation → gmeow:ParticipantRole]: The role(s) the participant played, drawn from the open gmeow:ParticipantRole value vocabulary. NON-FUNCTIONAL — mirroring gmeow:eventType: a participation may bear several roles, and competing standpoint-indexed role claims coexist (accordingTo) rather than contradict (Principle 9). Generalizes the former hasPrincipal / hasWitness / hasOfficiant subproperties.
- gmeow:periodContainsPeriod [gmeow:NamedPeriod → gmeow:NamedPeriod]: The transitive inverse of gmeow:periodPartOf.
- gmeow:periodEnd [gmeow:NamedPeriod → gmeow:Instant] (functional): The instant at which a named period ends.
- gmeow:periodPartOf [gmeow:NamedPeriod → gmeow:NamedPeriod]: Relates a named period to a larger named period that contains it (e.g. Holocene ⊂ Quaternary ⊂ Cenozoic). Transitive.
- gmeow:periodStart [gmeow:NamedPeriod → gmeow:Instant] (functional): The instant at which a named period begins.
- gmeow:periodType [gmeow:NamedPeriod → gmeow:PeriodType]: The kind(s) of a named period. Non-functional: competing classifications coexist.
- gmeow:physicalPlace [gmeow:StorageLocation → gmeow:Place]: The geographic place where a storage location's device physically sits (e.g. the room holding a disk). Absent for purely cloud storage.
- gmeow:pitch [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: Rotation about the lateral (typically y) axis, in degrees or radians as indicated by the reference frame.
- gmeow:placeDeterminacy [gmeow:Place → gmeow:Determinacy]: The ontic determinacy model of a place's existence or boundary — crisp, vague, fuzzy, probabilistic, or disputed. Non-functional: in a multi-source merge, sources may state different determinacy models, and those claims coexist.
- gmeow:placeSupersededBy [gmeow:Place → gmeow:Place]: Links a place to the place that replaced it — Constantinople placeSupersededBy Istanbul, a merged municipality placeSupersededBy its successor. Directional. The superseded place is retained (never deleted) and may carry gmeow:displayable false.
- gmeow:placeSupersedes [gmeow:Place → gmeow:Place]: Links a newer place to a prior one it supersedes. Inverse of gmeow:placeSupersededBy. Non-functional: one successor may consolidate several predecessors.
- gmeow:placeType [gmeow:Place → gmeow:PlaceType]: The kind(s) of a place (one or more gmeow:PlaceType individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (a place that is both 'city' and 'administrative area') and must coexist as evidence.
- gmeow:poseFrame [gmeow:Pose → gmeow:ReferenceFrame]: The coordinate reference frame in which the pose position and orientation are expressed.
- gmeow:postOfficeBox [gmeow:PostalAddress → rdfs:Literal]: The post-office-box of a postal address.
- gmeow:postalCode [gmeow:PostalAddress → rdfs:Literal]: The postal/ZIP code of a postal address.
- gmeow:preview [gmeow:Message → rdfs:Literal]: A short plain-text preview/snippet of a message's body.
- gmeow:proficiencyAgent [gmeow:LanguageProficiency → gmeow:Agent] (functional): The agent whose proficiency a language-proficiency expresses. Functional — constitutive of the proficiency.
- gmeow:proficiencyInterval [gmeow:LanguageProficiency → gmeow:TimeInterval]: The interval over which a language-proficiency held (proficiency changes over a life). Lighter cases use gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.
- gmeow:proficiencyLanguage [gmeow:LanguageProficiency → gmeow:Language] (functional): The language a language-proficiency concerns. Functional — constitutive.
- gmeow:proficiencyLevel [gmeow:LanguageProficiency → gmeow:ProficiencyLevel] (functional): The attained level of a language-proficiency (a gmeow:ProficiencyLevel value, e.g. cefrB2, levelNative). Functional.
- gmeow:proficiencyModality [gmeow:LanguageProficiency → gmeow:ProficiencyModality] (functional): The skill modality a language-proficiency rates (speaking, listening, reading, writing, signing, comprehension, overall) — a gmeow:ProficiencyModality value. Functional: mint one proficiency per (agent, language, modality) so per-skill levels coexist.
- gmeow:proficiencyScale [gmeow:LanguageProficiency → gmeow:ProficiencyScale] (functional): The framework/scale a proficiency level is measured on (CEFR, ILR, ACTFL, self-reported) — a gmeow:ProficiencyScale value. Functional.
- gmeow:profileAppliesTo [gmeow:Profile → ?]: The class of entities to which this Profile applies.
- gmeow:profileDescriptor [gmeow:Profile → ?]: A property that is part of this Profile's closed descriptor schema.
- gmeow:profileOpenValue [gmeow:Profile → ?]: An open value-vocabulary class (instances are individuals, never subclasses) used by this Profile.
- gmeow:pronounObject [gmeow:PronounSet → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The object (accusative) form of a pronoun set, e.g. "her", "them", "xem".
- gmeow:pronounPossessive [gmeow:PronounSet → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The possessive pronoun form of a pronoun set, e.g. "hers", "theirs", "xyrs".
- gmeow:pronounPossessiveDeterminer [gmeow:PronounSet → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The possessive determiner form of a pronoun set, e.g. "her", "their", "xyr".
- gmeow:pronounReflexive [gmeow:PronounSet → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The reflexive form of a pronoun set, e.g. "herself", "themself", "xemself".
- gmeow:pronounSubject [gmeow:PronounSet → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The subject (nominative) form of a pronoun set, e.g. "she", "they", "xe".
- gmeow:proximity [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:ProximityMeasurement]: Links an entity to a proximity measurement describing its distance or dissimilarity to another entity. The measurement carries the scalar value (via observationResult → ScalarQuantity), the reference frame (via hasReferenceFrame), and the target entity (via proximityTo). Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified Measurement when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.
- gmeow:proximityTo [gmeow:ProximityMeasurement → gmeow:Entity] (functional): The target entity to which proximity is measured. Functional: a different target entity is a different proximity measurement (constitutive of the relator's identity).
- gmeow:quantityUncertainty [gmeow:ScalarQuantity → xsd:decimal] (functional): The uncertainty (e.g. ±1 sigma) of a scalar quantity, in the same unit as the quantity value.
- gmeow:quantityValue [gmeow:ScalarQuantity → xsd:decimal] (functional): The numeric value of a scalar quantity.
- gmeow:quaternionW [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: The w (scalar) component of a unit quaternion representing orientation.
- gmeow:quaternionX [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: The x component of a unit quaternion representing orientation.
- gmeow:quaternionY [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: The y component of a unit quaternion representing orientation.
- gmeow:quaternionZ [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: The z component of a unit quaternion representing orientation.
- gmeow:rcc8dc [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Disconnected (DC) — regions are disjoint and do not share any point.
- gmeow:rcc8ec [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Externally Connected (EC) — regions share only boundary points.
- gmeow:rcc8eq [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Equal (EQ) — regions are identical.
- gmeow:rcc8ntpp [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Non-Tangential Proper Part (NTPP) — region is a proper part of another, entirely within its interior.
- gmeow:rcc8ntppi [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Non-Tangential Proper Part Inverse (NTPPi) — inverse of NTPP.
- gmeow:rcc8po [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Partial Overlap (PO) — regions overlap but neither is part of the other.
- gmeow:rcc8tpp [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Tangential Proper Part (TPP) — region is a proper part of another, sharing part of its boundary.
- gmeow:rcc8tppi [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: RCC-8: Tangential Proper Part Inverse (TPPi) — inverse of TPP.
- gmeow:receivedAt [gmeow:Message → xsd:dateTime]: When a message was received by the storing system (JMAP receivedAt / Gmail internalDate).
- gmeow:recordedNoLaterThan [? → xsd:dateTime]: A DERIVED upper bound (terminus ante quem) on when the annotated claim was committed to a record — typically taken from the modification time of its source carrier (gmeow:sourceModifiedAt) when no stronger observation time is known. Carries low gmeow:confidence; it is neither valid-time nor a point observation. Populate it in the importer/query layer, not by OWL inference.
- gmeow:recurrenceRuleText [gmeow:RecurrenceRule → xsd:string] (functional): The recurrence rule as an RFC 5545 RRULE string (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO). Projected directly to iCalendar RRULE; a SET-typed TIMEX3 in ISO-TimeML.
- gmeow:references [gmeow:Message → gmeow:Message]: Relates a message to an earlier message in its reference chain (RFC 5322 References).
- gmeow:registrationNumber [gmeow:Trademark → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The registry registration number of a trademark (e.g. a CIPO / USPTO / WIPO number).
- gmeow:relatedTag [gmeow:Tag → gmeow:Tag]: A tag related to this tag by an associative link. Symmetric. Optional.
- gmeow:relationshipChild [gmeow:ParentChildRelationship → gmeow:Person] (functional): The child in a reified parent-child relationship.
- gmeow:relationshipInterval [gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship → gmeow:TimeInterval]: The time interval over which an interpersonal relationship held. (A relator carries its period this way rather than via duringInterval, which is reserved for gufo:Situation-based time-scoped relations.)
- gmeow:relationshipParent [gmeow:ParentChildRelationship → gmeow:Person] (functional): The parent in a reified parent-child relationship.
- gmeow:relationshipParty [gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship → gmeow:Agent]: An agent who is one of the parties to an interpersonal relationship. Non-functional: a relationship typically binds two parties (and is left open for group ties).
- gmeow:relayAt [gmeow:RelayHop → xsd:dateTime] (functional): The server timestamp recorded for a relay hop.
- gmeow:relayBy [gmeow:RelayHop → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The server that performed a relay hop.
- gmeow:relayFrom [gmeow:RelayHop → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The host a relay hop received the message from.
- gmeow:relayProtocol [gmeow:RelayHop → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The protocol used for a relay hop (e.g. ESMTP, ESMTPS).
- gmeow:replyTo [gmeow:EmailMessage → gmeow:EmailAddress]: An address to which replies should be sent (RFC 5322 Reply-To).
- gmeow:requiresHost [gmeow:ReferenceFrame → xsd:boolean] (functional): Asserts whether a reference frame requires a hosting entity to exist.
- gmeow:residenceMailbox [gmeow:MailboxResidence → gmeow:Mailbox] (functional): The mailbox a mailbox-residence concerns.
- gmeow:residentMessage [gmeow:MailboxResidence → gmeow:Message] (functional): The message a mailbox-residence concerns.
- gmeow:residesIn [gmeow:Message → gmeow:Mailbox]: Relates a message to a mailbox/label it currently resides in. Time-varying residence is reified as gmeow:MailboxResidence; on this convenience property the period may be carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil.
- gmeow:rfcMessageId [gmeow:Message → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The RFC 5322 Message-ID of a message.
- gmeow:rightOperand [gmeow:AtomicConstraint → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The value an atomic constraint tests against (odrl:rightOperand), e.g. "2030-01-01", "EU", "5". For an IRI-valued operand use gmeow:rightOperandReference.
- gmeow:rightOperandReference [gmeow:AtomicConstraint → gmeow:Entity]: An IRI-valued right operand (odrl:rightOperandReference) — e.g. a place, party, or vocabulary individual the constraint tests against.
- gmeow:rightsType [gmeow:RightsStatement → gmeow:RightsType]: The kind(s) of intellectual-property right a statement concerns — one of the open gmeow:RightsType values (copyright, trademark, patent, industrial design, trade secret, related rights, moral rights, database right, plant breeders' rights). Non-functional: a statement may span several.
- gmeow:roll [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: Rotation about the longitudinal (typically x) axis, in degrees or radians as indicated by the reference frame.
- gmeow:romanization [gmeow:Appellation → rdfs:Literal]: A Latin-script transliteration of THIS SAME appellation in another script (e.g. "Yamada Tarō" for "山田太郎"; pinyin for a Chinese name). Strictly a transliteration of one name — it NEVER bridges two distinct co-equal names (a Mandarin name is not the romanization of a Latin one).
- gmeow:romanticOrientationValue [gmeow:RomanticOrientation → gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue] (functional): The gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue a romantic-orientation facet asserts (functional per facet). A predefined individual or a fresh one with rdfs:label; the single path to the value.
- gmeow:routeEnd [gmeow:Route → owl:Thing] (functional): The end of a route.
- gmeow:routeKind [gmeow:Route → gmeow:RouteKind] (functional): The kind of a route (a RouteKind individual).
- gmeow:routeStart [gmeow:Route → owl:Thing] (functional): The start of a route.
- gmeow:routeVia [gmeow:Route → owl:Thing]: An intermediate point that a route passes through. The order of via points is computed by the solver layer (Principle 12), not asserted in the OWL core.
- gmeow:ruleAction [gmeow:Rule → gmeow:RightsAction] (functional): The regulated action of a rule — one of the open gmeow:RightsAction values (odrl:action). Functional: a rule regulates exactly one action; several actions are several rules.
- gmeow:ruleAssignee [gmeow:Rule → gmeow:Agent]: The party a rule applies to (odrl:assignee). Absent means the rule applies to everyone (an open offer to the public).
- gmeow:ruleConsequence [gmeow:Rule → gmeow:Duty]: A duty triggered when a rule is unfulfilled or violated — the ODRL consequence (on a duty) / remedy (on a prohibition). The deontic chaining that makes a policy enforceable.
- gmeow:ruleConstraint [gmeow:Rule → gmeow:Constraint]: Relates a rule to a constraint that conditions it (odrl:constraint). A permission/prohibition/duty holds only when all its constraints are satisfied.
- gmeow:ruleTarget [gmeow:Rule → gmeow:Entity] (functional): The asset a rule regulates (odrl:target). Optional; absent when the rule inherits its target from the enclosing rights statement's gmeow:statementAbout.
- gmeow:scriptCode [gmeow:WritingSystem → rdfs:Literal]: The ISO 15924 script code of a writing system ("Latn", "Hani", "Hira", "Kana", "Arab", "Brai") when one exists, else a bespoke identifier for a conlang/AI script with no registered code. The bridge for names' gmeow:nameScript literals to resolve to a first-class WritingSystem. Non-functional.
- gmeow:scriptRole [gmeow:WritingSystemUsage → gmeow:ScriptRole] (functional): The functional role a writing system plays for a language in a usage (a gmeow:ScriptRole value). Functional: one role per usage — a script playing two roles is two usages.
- gmeow:scriptUsageInterval [gmeow:WritingSystemUsage → gmeow:TimeInterval]: The interval over which a writing-system-usage held — e.g. Turkish-in-Arabic-script until 1928. A relator carries its period this way (matching names' NameUsage); lighter cases use gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement. (Distinct from the names module's gmeow:usageInterval, which scopes a NameUsage.)
- gmeow:selfAsserted [gmeow:IdentityFacet → xsd:boolean]: Whether an identity facet was asserted by the person themselves (true — the top authority) rather than recorded or inferred by a third party (false). Non-functional: a multi-source merge may carry both a self-assertion and a third-party record, which coexist rather than force a contradiction.
- gmeow:sender [gmeow:EmailMessage → gmeow:EmailAddress]: The transmitting address of a message, where different from the author (RFC 5322 Sender).
- gmeow:sentAt [gmeow:Message → xsd:dateTime]: When a message was sent (RFC 5322 Date).
- gmeow:seriesOccurrence [gmeow:EventSeries → gmeow:Event]: Relates an event series to one of the concrete event occurrences it issues.
- gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth [gmeow:Person → gmeow:SexAssignedAtBirth]: The sex recorded for a person at birth (a gmeow:SexAssignedAtBirth value) — a RECORDED administrative datum, NOT a self-asserted identity and NOT a gufo IdentityFacet. Deliberately separate from gender identity/expression, which it never implies and is never implied by. Non-functional: a correction and a prior record coexist rather than contradict.
- gmeow:sexualOrientationValue [gmeow:SexualOrientation → gmeow:SexualOrientationValue] (functional): The gmeow:SexualOrientationValue a sexual-orientation facet asserts (functional per facet). A predefined individual or a fresh one with rdfs:label; the single path to the value.
- gmeow:sharpens [gmeow:Standpoint → gmeow:Standpoint]: S1 sharpens S2: every precisification S1 admits is also admitted by S2, so S1 is the more specific frame (the standpoint ⊆ / refinement relation of Standpoint Logic; CKR's coverage relation). Transitive. Every standpoint sharpens gmeow:universalStandpoint.
- gmeow:signatureAlgorithm [gmeow:CryptographicSignature → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The algorithm used for a signature (e.g. rsa-sha256, ed25519).
- gmeow:signedBy [gmeow:CryptographicSignature → gmeow:Agent]: The agent (or signing identity) that produced a signature.
- gmeow:signingDomain [gmeow:CryptographicSignature → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The domain asserted by a signature (e.g. the DKIM d= tag).
- gmeow:signingKey [gmeow:CryptographicSignature → gmeow:CryptographicKey] (functional): The cryptographic key that produced a signature (the trust module's CryptographicKey). Complements gmeow:signedBy: signedBy gives the identity, signingKey gives the key — the pair a gmeow:Certification attests.
- gmeow:sizeEstimate [gmeow:Message → xsd:integer]: The estimated size of a message in octets.
- gmeow:sourceLocation [gmeow:Source → rdfs:Literal]: Where the source artifact came from — a file path, original filename, or URL. Provenance/audit only; carries no reliable identity.
- gmeow:sourceModifiedAt [gmeow:Source → xsd:dateTime]: The last-modification time of the source artifact itself (e.g. a file mtime). A terminus-ante-quem on the recording of the claims this source carries — NOT valid-time (tenure) and NOT observation-time. Advisory and resettable; the reliable identity is gmeow:contentDigest. NOT functional: because a source is identified by its content digest, copies/syncs of the same bytes may legitimately report different modification times, which must coexist rather than force an inconsistency.
- gmeow:spatiallyConnectsTo [gmeow:Location → gmeow:Location]: Relates a location to another location it is spatially or topologically traversable to — a road segment, a network link, a portal, or a transit stop connection. Symmetric: the link can be traversed in either direction. A specialization of the universal gmeow:connectsTo spine. Distinct from gmeow:adjacentTo (RCC-8 EC: touching but not necessarily traversable) and from gmeow:containedInLocation (mereological containment).
- gmeow:spdxLicenseId [gmeow:License → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The SPDX License List short identifier of a licence — the canonical machine-readable licence id (e.g. "MIT", "Apache-2.0", "CC-BY-4.0", "GPL-3.0-only"). The bridge to the SPDX / SBOM world (spdx:licenseId); the SPDX List also assigns each id a stable IRI under http://spdx.org/licenses/. Functional: a licence has one canonical SPDX id (a compound choice is an SPDX licence expression in the same literal).
- gmeow:spdxLicenseName [gmeow:License → rdfs:Literal]: The full SPDX License List name of a licence (spdx:name), e.g. "Apache License 2.0".
- gmeow:standpointModality [? → gmeow:StandpointModality]: The belief value a standpoint assigns the annotated proposition — *how* the standpoint holds it, not merely *that* it holds it. This single axis is at least as expressive as BOTH the Standpoint-Logic modal operators (□_S / ◊_S) AND the CRMinf belief value (true / false / probable / possible): gmeow:unequivocal (□, settled true), gmeow:probable (likely true), gmeow:conceivable (◊, possible), gmeow:refuted (□¬, settled false — the standpoint DENIES the proposition). Optional; ABSENT is read as unequivocal. Orthogonal to gmeow:confidence (our certainty about the standpoint's stance) and gmeow:accordingTo (whose frame). Refutation is what lets GMEOW distinguish a standpoint's explicit denial from its silence — the neutral-stance ambiguity flat models cannot resolve.
- gmeow:startedAtTime [gmeow:TimeInterval → xsd:dateTime] (functional): The instant at which a time interval begins.
- gmeow:startedBy [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Allen STARTED-BY: inverse of gmeow:starts. (= time:intervalStartedBy; TimeML BEGUN_BY; TEO startedBy.)
- gmeow:starts [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Allen STARTS: this event and the related event begin together, and this one ends first (it is an initial sub-span). NOT transitive. Inverse of gmeow:startedBy. (= time:intervalStarts; TimeML BEGINS; TEO starts.)
- gmeow:statementAbout [gmeow:RightsStatement → gmeow:Entity]: The asset a rights statement governs — the ODRL target. Usually the inverse of gmeow:hasRightsStatement; asserted on the relator so the statement is self-contained.
- gmeow:storageMedium [gmeow:StorageLocation → gmeow:StorageMedium] (functional): The medium of a storage location (a gmeow:StorageMedium individual). Functional: the medium is constitutive of the storage location (a different medium is a different store) — unlike the descriptive, multi-source gmeow:placeType.
- gmeow:storagePath [gmeow:StorageLocation → rdfs:Literal]: The path, key, or URI of a storage location within its service.
- gmeow:storageService [gmeow:StorageLocation → rdfs:Literal]: The service or system hosting a storage location (e.g. "Google Drive", "AWS S3", "local").
- gmeow:storedIn [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:StorageLocation]: Relates a digital object (e.g. a document or import source) to the storage location where its bytes reside — the structured form of a source's location.
- gmeow:streetAddress [gmeow:PostalAddress → rdfs:Literal]: The street address line (number and thoroughfare) of a postal address.
- gmeow:subEventOf [gmeow:Event → gmeow:Event]: Relates an event to a larger event it is part of — a talk within a session within a conference. Transitive: a part of a part is a part (CIDOC-CRM P9 consists of). A specialization of the universal gmeow:partOf spine. Non-simple, so kept out of all cardinality axioms.
- gmeow:subOrganizationOf [gmeow:Organization → gmeow:Organization]: Relates an organization to a larger organization it is part of — a department or division within a company, a team within a department. Transitive (a team is part of the company through its division). A specialization of the universal gmeow:partOf spine. A department is thus a first-class gmeow:Organization, and a gmeow:Membership may target it directly. The 'department' field is the sub-organization a person's membership is in.
- gmeow:subject [gmeow:Message → rdfs:Literal]: The subject line of a message (RFC 5322 Subject).
- gmeow:supersededBy [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Entity]: Links an entity to the entity that replaced it — Constantinople supersededBy Istanbul, the Soviet Union supersededBy the Russian Federation, a deprecated software release supersededBy its successor. Directional, NOT symmetric. The superseded entity is retained (never deleted) and may carry gmeow:displayable false.
- gmeow:supersedes [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Entity]: Relates a newer entity, version, record, or claim-bearing artifact to a prior one it supersedes. Non-functional: one successor may consolidate several predecessors. Superseded entities remain first-class and usable; suppression from display is handled separately with gmeow:displayable false when appropriate.
- gmeow:tagInScheme [gmeow:Tag → gmeow:TagScheme]: Relates a tag to a scheme it belongs to. Non-functional: a tag may reside in many schemes (cross-listing).
- gmeow:taggingInterval [gmeow:Tagging → gmeow:TimeInterval]: The time interval over which the tagging act holds. A relator carries its period this way (matching gmeow:usageInterval, gmeow:relationshipInterval) rather than via RDF-star annotations on the relator node.
- gmeow:taggingScheme [gmeow:Tagging → gmeow:TagScheme] (functional): The tag scheme within which the tagging act is performed. Functional per relator: one scheme per Tagging (the tag itself may belong to multiple schemes).
- gmeow:taggingTag [gmeow:Tagging → gmeow:Tag] (functional): The tag applied in a tagging act. Functional per relator: one tag per Tagging.
- gmeow:taggingTagged [gmeow:Tagging → gmeow:Entity] (functional): The entity that is tagged in a tagging act. Functional per relator: one tagged entity per Tagging.
- gmeow:taggingTagger [gmeow:Tagging → gmeow:Agent]: The agent who performed the tagging act. Non-functional: a tag may be co-asserted by multiple agents (e.g. a collaborative curation effort).
- gmeow:telephone [gmeow:Agent → rdfs:Literal]: A telephone number at which an agent can be reached.
- gmeow:temporalPrecision [gmeow:Event → gmeow:TemporalPrecision]: The granularity to which an event's time is known — a gmeow:TemporalPrecision value (day / month / year / decade / circa). Makes the determinacy of a date explicit instead of pretending every date is to-the-day.
- gmeow:tenurePosition [gmeow:StandpointTenure → ?]: The standpoint-indexed claim the tenure says the standpoint held over its interval — a reified statement (a gmeow:StatementMetadata cell in the statement DSL). The range is intentionally left open: the statement-DSL spec layer is not part of the reasoned import closure, so asserting it as rdfs:range would dangle in the merged graph.
- gmeow:tenureStandpoint [gmeow:StandpointTenure → gmeow:Standpoint] (functional): The standpoint whose position a standpoint-tenure records.
- gmeow:tenuredContactPoint [gmeow:AddressTenure → gmeow:ContactPoint] (functional): The contact point an address-tenure concerns.
- gmeow:textDirection [gmeow:WritingSystem → gmeow:TextDirection]: The writing direction(s) of a writing system (gmeow:TextDirection values). Non-functional — Japanese is both vertical-rtl and ltr.
- gmeow:timezone [gmeow:Location → rdfs:Literal]: An IANA time-zone identifier for a location (e.g. "America/Edmonton"). Non-functional: a large place may span several zones.
- gmeow:title [gmeow:CreativeWork → rdfs:Literal]: The title of a creative work.
- gmeow:to [gmeow:EmailMessage → gmeow:EmailAddress]: A primary recipient address of a message (RFC 5322 To).
- gmeow:trademarkHolder [gmeow:Trademark → gmeow:Agent]: The agent that holds a trademark (the proprietor). A specialisation of gmeow:wasAttributedTo. Non-functional: a mark may be jointly held.
- gmeow:trademarkMark [gmeow:Trademark → gmeow:Mark] (functional): The mark a trademark protects. Functional.
- gmeow:trademarkStatus [gmeow:Trademark → gmeow:TrademarkStatus] (functional): The status of a trademark — one of the gmeow:TrademarkStatus values (unregistered ™ / registered ® / pending / expired / cancelled). Functional.
- gmeow:transformsTo [gmeow:ReferenceFrame → gmeow:ReferenceFrame]: Relates a reference frame to another frame it can be mathematically transformed to.
- gmeow:transliterationScheme [gmeow:Appellation → gmeow:TransliterationScheme]: The named transliteration/romanization system that produced an appellation's gmeow:romanization (Hepburn vs Kunrei for Japanese; Pinyin vs Wade-Giles for Mandarin). Records HOW the romanization was derived. Non-functional. Domain gmeow:Appellation retrofits the names module; the scheme individuals are catalogued as FnO functions in the projection layer.
- gmeow:trustLevel [gmeow:TrustAssertion → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The degree of owner-trust expressed: ultimate, full, marginal, or none.
- gmeow:trustee [gmeow:TrustAssertion → gmeow:Agent] (functional): The agent that is trusted by the trustor in a trust-assertion.
- gmeow:trustor [gmeow:TrustAssertion → gmeow:Agent] (functional): The agent whose (subjective) trust a trust-assertion expresses — the perspective holder.
- gmeow:usageAppellation [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:Appellation] (functional): The appellation used to call the named entity in a name-usage.
- gmeow:usageAudience [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:Entity]: The audience or scope in which the appellation is used — an Agent, a Group/Family, or a locale community. Range is gmeow:Entity to admit all of them. Non-functional. ('Aunt Genny' is used toward the family; 欧德理 toward a Sinophone audience.)
- gmeow:usageAuthority [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:Agent]: The naming / toponymic authority behind a name-usage — the gmeow:Agent (a national mapping agency, a standards body, an indigenous community, or a self-asserting individual) that confers or sanctions the appellation in this use. NON-FUNCTIONAL: joint or competing authorities coexist with no privileged claimant (anti-colonial, Principle 9), each attributable and confidence-weighted. (Introduced as namingAuthority by issue #105; named usageAuthority for usage* consistency.)
- gmeow:usageInfo [gmeow:Entity → rdfs:Literal]: Human-readable supplementary usage / licensing information (schema:usageInfo).
- gmeow:usageInterval [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:TimeInterval]: The time interval over which a name-usage held. (A relator carries its period this way — matching contacts' relationshipInterval — rather than via duringInterval.)
- gmeow:usageLanguage [gmeow:WritingSystemUsage → gmeow:Language] (functional): The language that uses the writing system in a writing-system-usage. Functional — constitutive of the usage (a usage binds exactly one language).
- gmeow:usageNamed [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:Entity] (functional): The entity that is called by the appellation in a name-usage.
- gmeow:usageNamer [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:Agent]: An agent who uses the appellation for the named entity — the speaker/perspective holder. Non-functional: a usage may be shared by an audience of agents.
- gmeow:usageRegister [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:NameRegister] (functional): The social register of a name-usage (formal, intimate, professional, casual) — a gmeow:NameRegister value individual.
- gmeow:usageRelationshipScope [gmeow:NameUsage → gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship] (functional): The interpersonal relationship that scopes a name-usage (e.g. the aunt-niece tie within which 'Aunt Genny' is used) — reuses the contacts relator. A sharper alternative to gmeow:usageAudience when the scope is exactly one standing relationship.
- gmeow:usageWritingSystem [gmeow:WritingSystemUsage → gmeow:WritingSystem] (functional): The writing system used by the language in a writing-system-usage. Functional — constitutive of the usage.
- gmeow:usesWritingSystem [gmeow:Language → gmeow:WritingSystem]: Relates a language to a writing system it is written in — the direct relation. Non-functional and CO-EQUAL: Japanese uses Han, Hiragana, Katakana and Latin simultaneously, none primary. When role or period matter, reify the binding as gmeow:WritingSystemUsage.
- gmeow:validFrom [? → xsd:dateTime]: The instant from which the annotated statement is asserted to hold.
- gmeow:validUntil [? → xsd:dateTime]: The instant until which the annotated statement is asserted to hold.
- gmeow:vantage [gmeow:Observation → gmeow:Agent]: The agent or standpoint from which the observation is made — the reified-object-property counterpart of gmeow:accordingTo. Semantically, gmeow:vantage ⊑ gmeow:accordingTo: when an annotated statement is promoted to a reified Observation, its gmeow:accordingTo becomes the gmeow:vantage of the relator. The agent in the vantage role — an observer, a sensor, a perceiver — IS a standpoint (Principle 9): no frame is privileged, and every vantage is a co-equal facet from which the claim is held. Range is gmeow:Agent (person, organization, software agent, sensor) rather than only gmeow:Standpoint, because the common case is a bare agent; use a gmeow:Standpoint individual when the frame needs its own identity. Non-functional: joint observations (a reading co-authored by two agencies) are valid.
- gmeow:verificationStatus [gmeow:CryptographicSignature → rdfs:Literal] (functional): The verification outcome of a signature: verified, failed, or unverified.
- gmeow:versionLabel [gmeow:Language → rdfs:Literal]: The version designation of a language as a literal ("1993", "2011", "New Ithkuil", "v2.1"). Domain is gmeow:Language (not only LanguageVersion) so a lineage may carry a current-version label. Non-functional.
- gmeow:versionOf [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Entity] (functional): Relates a concrete version entity to the stable lineage entity it versions: a language version to its language, a software release to its project, a data release to its dataset, or a work version to its work. Functional because a version belongs to one lineage, but the lineage may have many versions.
- gmeow:virtualPlatform [gmeow:VirtualLocation → rdfs:Literal]: The platform hosting a virtual location (Zoom, Meet, a chat service, …).
- gmeow:wasAssociatedWith [gmeow:Activity → gmeow:Agent]: Relates an activity to an agent associated with carrying it out — e.g. the software agent that ran an import. (Activity→Agent; the counterpart of gmeow:wasAttributedTo, which ascribes an endurant Entity to an agent.)
- gmeow:wasAttributedTo [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Agent]: Ascribes responsibility for an entity to an agent.
- gmeow:wasDerivedFrom [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Entity]: Relates a derived entity to the entity it was derived from — e.g. a text extraction, summary, or embedding to its source. The derivation's confidence and generating agent are recorded with gmeow:confidence and gmeow:wasGeneratedBy.
- gmeow:wasGeneratedBy [gmeow:Entity → gmeow:Activity]: Relates an entity to the activity that produced it.
- gmeow:writingSystemType [gmeow:WritingSystem → gmeow:WritingSystemType]: The structural kind(s) of a writing system (gmeow:WritingSystemType values). Non-functional — a script may be classified plurally.
- gmeow:writtenInLanguage [gmeow:SoftwareProject → gmeow:ProgrammingLanguage]: Relates a software project to a first-class gmeow:ProgrammingLanguage it is written in. Non-functional — a project uses several languages.
- gmeow:yaw [gmeow:Orientation → xsd:double]: Rotation about the vertical (typically z) axis, in degrees or radians as indicated by the reference frame.

## Individuals

- gmeow:actionAcceptTracking (a gmeow:RightsAction): Accept that use of the asset may be tracked (odrl:acceptTracking).
- gmeow:actionAggregate (a gmeow:RightsAction): Use the asset within an aggregation with other assets (odrl:aggregate).
- gmeow:actionAnnotate (a gmeow:RightsAction): Add explanatory notations to the asset (odrl:annotate).
- gmeow:actionAnonymize (a gmeow:RightsAction): Anonymise identifying information in the asset (odrl:anonymize).
- gmeow:actionArchive (a gmeow:RightsAction): Store the asset for long-term preservation (odrl:archive).
- gmeow:actionAttribute (a gmeow:RightsAction): Credit the rights holder (odrl:attribute; cc:Attribution) — typically the action of an attribution duty.
- gmeow:actionCommercialize (a gmeow:RightsAction): Use the asset for commercial advantage (odrl:commercialize; cc:CommercialUse).
- gmeow:actionCompensate (a gmeow:RightsAction): Compensate the assigner by payment (odrl:compensate) — typically a duty.
- gmeow:actionConcurrentUse (a gmeow:RightsAction): Permit a limited number of concurrent uses (odrl:concurrentUse).
- gmeow:actionDelete (a gmeow:RightsAction): Permanently remove all copies of the asset (odrl:delete).
- gmeow:actionDerive (a gmeow:RightsAction): Create derivative / adapted works from the asset (odrl:derive; cc:DerivativeWorks).
- gmeow:actionDigitize (a gmeow:RightsAction): Produce a digital copy of a physical asset (odrl:digitize).
- gmeow:actionDisplay (a gmeow:RightsAction): Display the asset, e.g. on screen (odrl:display).
- gmeow:actionDistribute (a gmeow:RightsAction): Distribute / publish copies of the asset (odrl:distribute; cc:Distribution).
- gmeow:actionEnsureExclusivity (a gmeow:RightsAction): Guarantee exclusivity of the granted rights (odrl:ensureExclusivity) — a duty.
- gmeow:actionExecute (a gmeow:RightsAction): Run / execute the asset (e.g. software) (odrl:execute).
- gmeow:actionExtract (a gmeow:RightsAction): Extract part of the asset (odrl:extract) — e.g. for text/data mining.
- gmeow:actionGive (a gmeow:RightsAction): Transfer ownership of the asset to another party without compensation (odrl:give).
- gmeow:actionGrantUse (a gmeow:RightsAction): Grant the use of the asset to third parties (odrl:grantUse).
- gmeow:actionInclude (a gmeow:RightsAction): Include other related assets in the asset (odrl:include).
- gmeow:actionIndex (a gmeow:RightsAction): Record the asset in an index (odrl:index).
- gmeow:actionInform (a gmeow:RightsAction): Inform a party that an action has occurred (odrl:inform) — a duty.
- gmeow:actionInstall (a gmeow:RightsAction): Install the asset on a device (odrl:install).
- gmeow:actionLease (a gmeow:RightsAction): Make the asset available for use for a period in return for payment (odrl:lease).
- gmeow:actionLend (a gmeow:RightsAction): Make the asset available for temporary use without transferring ownership (odrl:lend).
- gmeow:actionModify (a gmeow:RightsAction): Change existing content of the asset (odrl:modify).
- gmeow:actionMove (a gmeow:RightsAction): Move the asset from one digital location to another, deleting the original (odrl:move).
- gmeow:actionNextPolicy (a gmeow:RightsAction): Apply a subsequent policy to a re-distributed asset (odrl:nextPolicy).
- gmeow:actionObtainConsent (a gmeow:RightsAction): Obtain the holder's prior consent before exercising a permission (odrl:obtainConsent).
- gmeow:actionPlay (a gmeow:RightsAction): Render the asset as audio/video (odrl:play).
- gmeow:actionPresent (a gmeow:RightsAction): Publicly present, perform or display the asset (odrl:present).
- gmeow:actionPrint (a gmeow:RightsAction): Create a hard-copy rendition of the asset (odrl:print).
- gmeow:actionProcessPersonalData (a gmeow:RightsAction): Process personal data about a data subject — the privacy-regulated action (aligned to dpv:Processing and odrl:use).
- gmeow:actionRead (a gmeow:RightsAction): Obtain data from the asset (odrl:read).
- gmeow:actionReproduce (a gmeow:RightsAction): Make copies of the asset (odrl:reproduce; cc:Reproduction).
- gmeow:actionRetainNotice (a gmeow:RightsAction): Preserve copyright / licence notices (cc:Notice) — typically the action of a notice duty.
- gmeow:actionReviewPolicy (a gmeow:RightsAction): Review the policy applicable to the asset (odrl:reviewPolicy) — a duty.
- gmeow:actionSell (a gmeow:RightsAction): Transfer ownership of the asset in return for payment (odrl:sell).
- gmeow:actionShareAlike (a gmeow:RightsAction): Distribute derivatives under the same licence (odrl:shareAlike; cc:ShareAlike) — typically the action of a share-alike duty.
- gmeow:actionStream (a gmeow:RightsAction): Deliver the asset as a real-time stream (odrl:stream).
- gmeow:actionSynchronize (a gmeow:RightsAction): Use the asset in timed relation with another asset (odrl:synchronize).
- gmeow:actionTextToSpeech (a gmeow:RightsAction): Render text of the asset as synthesized speech (odrl:textToSpeech).
- gmeow:actionTransfer (a gmeow:RightsAction): Transfer ownership of the asset to another party (odrl:transfer).
- gmeow:actionTransform (a gmeow:RightsAction): Convert the asset into a different format (odrl:transform).
- gmeow:actionTranslate (a gmeow:RightsAction): Translate the asset into another language (odrl:translate).
- gmeow:actionUninstall (a gmeow:RightsAction): Remove an installed asset from a device (odrl:uninstall).
- gmeow:actionUse (a gmeow:RightsAction): Use the asset (the broad odrl:use action).
- gmeow:actionWatermark (a gmeow:RightsAction): Apply a watermark to the asset (odrl:watermark) — a duty.
- gmeow:aggAverage (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The arithmetic mean of a numeric property over entities within the aggregation region.
- gmeow:aggCentroid (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The geometric centre of the aggregation region or of the entities within it. Computed by the solver layer (Principle 12).
- gmeow:aggCount (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The number of entities within the aggregation region.
- gmeow:aggDensity (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The number of entities per unit area within the aggregation region. Computed by the solver layer (Principle 12).
- gmeow:aggMaximum (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The largest value of a numeric property over entities within the aggregation region.
- gmeow:aggMinimum (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The smallest value of a numeric property over entities within the aggregation region.
- gmeow:aggSum (a gmeow:AggregationFunction): The arithmetic sum of a numeric property over entities within the aggregation region.
- gmeow:aspectNone (a gmeow:GrammaticalAspect): ISO-TimeML aspect NONE.
- gmeow:aspectPerfective (a gmeow:GrammaticalAspect): ISO-TimeML aspect PERFECTIVE.
- gmeow:aspectPerfectiveProgressive (a gmeow:GrammaticalAspect): ISO-TimeML aspect PERFECTIVE_PROGRESSIVE.
- gmeow:aspectProgressive (a gmeow:GrammaticalAspect): ISO-TimeML aspect PROGRESSIVE.

- gmeow:copyrightStatusInCopyright (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): The work is protected by copyright (RightsStatements.org InC).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusInCopyrightEducationalUse (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): In copyright, educational use permitted (RightsStatements.org InC-EDU).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusInCopyrightEuOrphanWork (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): In copyright, an EU orphan work (RightsStatements.org InC-OW-EU).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusInCopyrightNonCommercialUse (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): In copyright, non-commercial use permitted (RightsStatements.org InC-NC).

- gmeow:copyrightStatusNoCopyrightOtherLegalRestrictions (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): No copyright, other known legal restrictions (RightsStatements.org NoC-OKLR).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusNoCopyrightUnitedStates (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): No copyright in the United States (RightsStatements.org NoC-US).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusNoKnownCopyright (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): No copyright is known to subsist, after evaluation (RightsStatements.org NKC).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusNotEvaluated (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): The copyright status has not been evaluated (RightsStatements.org CNE).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusPublicDomain (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): The work is in the public domain (the CC public-domain mark; RightsStatements.org NoC-related).
- gmeow:copyrightStatusUndetermined (a gmeow:CopyrightStatus): Copyright undetermined (RightsStatements.org UND).
